overrides.reason: Confirmed, not changed: PHAGE's Phage_DMX encodes every Halo Beam's pan and tilt through this type's DMX ranges, decodes them back, rebuilds the beam with this sense and compares it with the beam PHAGE's renderer draws for the same pose: worst error 0.04 degrees over 100 movers, held and moving (16-bit quantisation).

source.document: PHAGE Phage_DMX verify pass (projects/phage_stage/modules/Phage_DMX/verify.hlsl), beam_error_deg control output
source.note: Sentinel's own design: tools/phage_gdtf.py writes this type from the renderer's constants (modules/_shared/phage_fixture.hlsli); measured 2026-10-03 on Sentinel 0.6.4
